# netbox_rack_reservation (Data Source)

Retrieves a single rack reservation from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_rack_reservation" "example" {
  id      = 1
  rack_id = 1
}

output "rack_reservation_id" {
  value = data.netbox_rack_reservation.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the rack reservation.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the rack reservation.
- `rack_id` (Number) The ID of the rack associated with the rack reservation.
- `status` (String) The status of the rack reservation.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the rack reservation.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the rack reservation.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the rack reservation.
- `created` (String) The created of the rack reservation.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the rack reservation, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the rack reservation.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the rack reservation.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `unit_count` (Number) The unit count of the rack reservation.
- `units` (List of Number) The units of the rack reservation.
